This lesson is all about booking calls and getting people to actually show up.
A booked call that doesn't show is worth nothing, so show rate is everything.
First thing. Confirm the booking within five minutes. A fast confirmation tells them this is real.
Second thing. The reminder ladder. Twenty-four hours before, two hours before, ten minutes before.
Every reminder gives value. Send a short video, a question to think about, a case breakdown you have permission to share.
Never send a reminder that just says don't forget.
Third thing. Ask them to reply to confirm. People who reply show up far more often.
Fourth thing. Book close. Try to book within forty-eight hours. Every extra day drops the show rate.
Now what about no-shows. No-show recovery is a skill.
Message the no-show within fifteen minutes. Be kind. Life happens.
Offer two new times. Not a link to the whole calendar, two specific times.
If they don't respond after two tries, they go to nurture. We don't chase forever.
What's a good show rate. Sixty percent is the floor. If you're under fifty, treat it as an emergency.
The most common reason for a bad show rate is booking people who were never qualified.
So qualify before you send the link. Ask about their goal, their timeline and whether they can invest.
Last thing. The pre-call brief. Before every call the closer gets a short brief.
Goal, current numbers, main obstacle, what they said in the DMs.
That's it. Go fix your reminder ladder this week.
